classification: Blank assessment template — NOT a measured example
disallowed_calculations: Do not treat 5 assessed acres or 5.01 internally logged acres as a validated runoff-model footprint.
Do not treat a reported seeding operation as documented successful establishment or incremental ecosystem benefit.
Do not treat promotional poster ecosystem-service dollars, restoration costs, or returns as verified project outcomes.
Do not turn statewide benefit-transfer totals into site-specific incremental gains without a compatible baseline.
next_measurements: Publicly releasable GIS polygon for assessed, seeded and financially evaluated extents, with distinct boundaries.
Matched vegetation surveys (native/exotic percent cover and structure) and repeatable protocol.
Documented soil map unit, compaction or infiltration and modeled annual runoff under both conditions.
Dated detailed mowing labor/equipment records and actual restoration costs, before and after.
Documented baseline/post-treatment carbon and biodiversity monitoring if those benefits will be claimed.
